title: Peter Twigg Meditation | Beyond Belief, Into Knowing — a One-Year Course
subtitle: Meditation beyond belief, into knowing — the direct, first-hand experience of the Self, taught by Peter Twigg (forty years' practice, thirty years teaching). Join the School of Knowing one-year course in consciousness and spiritual meditation.

posts.title: The Light in Their Faces
posts.description: Back from the Camino — a first letter home: the people, the light in their faces, and how simple living makes room for what the noise had hidden.

posts.title: An Update, and a Farewell for a While
posts.description: Peter Twigg is stepping off the page to walk the Camino — an update, a farewell for a while, and a door left open for anyone ready to begin.

posts.title: Knitted Whole Again
posts.description: The coagula — what the unmaking was always for. The survivor of the descent becomes the maker, and what gets built is congealed light. With Descartes as the false coagula.
